overall.verdict: Mobile light is a competent wallet shell with a strong total, bilateral notch, and receipt proof, but light chrome (cards, chips, black selected pills, clipped tabs) is noisier than the dark-premium brief. The one-scale bar is explained in Settings and contradicted everywhere else by shortened Home bars, absent Activity/Swap marks, and Receive’s fake fade.
priority_fixes: Enforce one px/$ scale at full content width on Home USDC, Hub, Pay, Account; fade overflow; never shrink bars to “fit.”
Delete redundant legends/chips (Home tier list, hub chip, Pay Arrives/Delivery, Receive triple copy, Account four-key legend vs two-tone bar).
Fix mobile chrome: cropped Receive QR, clipped Activity Accou chip, Settings/Account copy under the tab bar, dual X+Done on sheets.
Unify receipts (Pay sheet vs Activity detail): one amount, frame, time, proof, committed-frame footer; drop 2692 ms.
Replace black selected pills (Activity All, Settings Auto) with indigo; equal-weight Pay/Receive/Swap on Home so the total stays the hero.
